candidate_program.name: local_bound_caution
candidate_program.rationale: Scores a normalized margin against a neighborhood cover estimate and penalizes disagreement with feasible greedy packing. Its reach stays local, but computing both estimates may consume substantial time.
candidate_program.rule: (weight - neighbor_cover) / (1 + weight + neighbor_cover) - 0.1 * max(0, neighbor_cover - neighbor_pack) / (1 + neighbor_cover) + 0.05 * weight / ((1 + weight) * (1 + degree))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
